frontmatter.title: pull_request vs. pull_request_target: The GitHub Actions Trigger Hiding a Security Nightmare
frontmatter.subheading: Understanding the critical difference between these two triggers and why one could give attackers RCE on your repository.
frontmatter.excerpt: Learn the security-critical distinction between `pull_request` and `pull_request_target` in GitHub Actions. One is safe for forks, the other could expose your secrets and code.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
